# opnsense_tailscale_subnet (Data Source)

Subnets this firewall advertises to the tailnet (**VPN ▸ Tailscale ▸ Settings ▸ Advertised routes**, plugin `os-tailscale`). Routes must also be approved in the Tailscale admin console unless auto-approved.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the Tailscale subnet.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `subnet` (String) Network in CIDR notation, e.g. `10.0.10.0/24`.
